title.en: The Same 6600 mm Outline Does Not Order Electric 80
title.zh: 相同的 6600 mm 外形订不出电动80

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm on both Electric 60 and Electric 80. Weights are 3300 kg and 6000 kg. Motors are 90 kW and 110 kW.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm 同时印在电动60和电动80上。重量是 3300 kg 和 6000 kg。电机是 90 kW 和 110 kW。

h1.en: Match the Motor After the Outline Matches
h1.zh: 外形对上之后还要对照电机

directAnswer.en: A buyer who measures a frame of 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm still has two electric pages at Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric 60 is 90 kW, 40 m³/h, 35 MPa, hopper 0.7 m³ and 3300 kg, with three stone rows. Electric 80 is 110 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, hopper 0.7 m³, 900 m / 300 m and 6000 kg. The shared hopper figure and the shared outline do not choose the path. Write the kilowatts in the inquiry to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/). No price is printed.
directAnswer.zh: 量到外形 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm 的买家，在河北品锦机械（邢台）仍然面对两张电动页。电动60是 90 kW、40 m³/h、35 MPa、料斗 0.7 m³、3300 kg，并有三行石子。电动80是 110 kW、60 m³/h、40 MPa、料斗 0.7 m³、900 m / 300 m、6000 kg。相同的料斗数字和相同的外形选不出路径。把千瓦写进发往 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/) 的询盘。没有印价格。

body.en: Only Electric 80 prints 900 m / 300 m. Electric 60’s fine-stone pair is 200 m / 600 m. A measured line near 900 m is not an Electric 60 cell.
body.zh: 只有电动80印 900 m / 300 m。电动60的细石是 200 m / 600 m。接近 900 m 的实测管路不是电动60的格子。

body.en: HBT80-16 prints 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm, not 1800 mm of width. Do not fold it into this pair.
body.zh: HBT80-16 印 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm，宽度不是 1800 mm。不要把它并进这一对。

body.en: Use 3300 kg or 6000 kg with the path. One crate description cannot carry both.
body.zh: 按路径使用 3300 kg 或 6000 kg。一份箱子说明不能同时带两个重量。

question.zh: 两者都印料斗 0.7 m³ 吗？

answer.en: Yes. That cell matches. Motor, output, pressure, distance and weight do not all match.
answer.zh: 是。这一格相同。电机、输送量、压力、距离和重量并不全部相同。

question.en: Does the outline include a price?

alt.zh: 电动60型混凝土泵，由河北品锦机械厂家制造，邢台
